description: Search upcoming public events, activities and meetups on Moments in one city. Filter by time window, category, free entry or a text query. Returns event titles, times, venues, prices and the event page URL. Event texts come from third-party organizers. Data is public Moments event listings for Norwegian and other cities. Event texts come from third-party organizers.

category.description: Category: musikk (music), kultur (culture), mat (food), sport, sosialt (social), workshops, gaming.

city.description: City slug, for example oslo. Use list_cities for the full list.

query.description: Free-text search, for example jazz or quiz.

when.description: Time window: i-dag (today), i-morgen (tomorrow), helgen (this weekend), denne-uken (this week), neste-uke (next week), gratis (free events). Omit for all upcoming.

name: search_events
title: Search Events
